tasks.subject: Task 0: Validate review sources (Phase 0 gate)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Go/no-go on whether G2, Capterra, Trustpilot can be scraped for real customer quotes. The launch angle rests on this.

**Spike, not TDD.** Script is throwaway.

**Decision rule:** 2+ sources with real quotes -> proceed. Only 1 -> target only that one. None -> STOP and escalate to user.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/spike-sources.ts", "docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-16-phase-0-findings.md"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsx scripts/spike-sources.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["3 review sources probed against 5 brands", "findings file records working URL patterns", "explicit go/no-go recorded"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 12: Teardown store and API route
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The single endpoint tying it together — cache lookup, collect, synthesize, store, return.

**Critical verification:** manually confirm every claim ends with an [id] present in the evidence array. This is the acceptance test for the entire product thesis.

**WATCH OUT:** maxDuration = 120 exceeds the Vercel Hobby limit. If deploy rejects it, surface to the user — do not silently lower it.

**Files:** lib/teardownStore.ts, app/api/teardown/route.ts

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/teardownStore.ts", "app/api/teardown/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cached served without scraping", "every claim carries a valid citation", "400/429/422 handled"]}
```
